summary: Both pairs of noise-cancelling headphones played the same three recorded scenes: a train carriage, a busy café and an open-plan office with a video call running. The Bose QuietComfort Headphones kept more of the low rumble and the nearby chatter out, stayed comfortable through a long session and left the caller's voice clearer on the other end. The Sony WH-1000XM5 let more of the chatter through and was heavier on the head by the end. Recommendation: Bose QuietComfort Headphones.
